design.split: h = h_par + h_perp with h_par = <h, n_hat> n_hat, n_hat = n_carrier / ||n_carrier||
design.decodability: trace-scaled ridge R^2 (where_info_dies.decode_ridge) from the layer state (last token) to the next patch's complex host-band coefficient (where_info_dies.tone_target); nested = held-out with the penalty by inner CV; null = the same with a phase-permuted target
design.splice: exp 2 only: a forward hook on stacked_xf[SPLICE_LAYER-1] replaces the block-19 output (block-20 input) with the constructed state; the head is pointwise, so block 20 alone acts.  Pattern from patching.run_splice.
design.interp: h(alpha) = (1-alpha) h19(4, phi) + alpha h19(5, phi), full (1, 16, 1280) state tensor, alpha in {0,.2,...,1}
design.caveat: interpolated states are OOD inputs to block 20 (affine combinations of two on-manifold tone states); the curve is block 20's response along that direction.  The {4}/{5} endpoint norms differ ~2x at block 19, so alpha weights the *direction* unevenly; curve_norm_matched rescales the {4} endpoint to ||h19(5)|| as a robustness check
design.amp_convention: a component with amp a in A_TONE units has power a^2 (A_TONE=sqrt 2); mixtures use a=sqrt(0.5) per component (total power 1)

P1.statement: the host-band information is almost entirely in h_perp (R2 from h_par ~0, from h_perp ~full) at EVERY layer

P2.statement: block 20 shrinks the h_par norm share for trained content, leaving the null/mixture arms (relatively) unchanged

P3.statement: block 20's response curve along the 4->5 interpolation is GRADED/smooth (C), not a step (B)

P4.statement: the real mixture state's response sits near the pure-null end (the mixture is null-like to block 20)

P5.statement: the response correlates with the input state's own carrier-cos (the map acts as a function of where the input sits)
